europe_now.title: Romanian jet downs drone near Black Sea gas platform
europe_now.summary: A Romanian fighter jet destroyed a drone near an offshore gas production platform in the Black Sea, with President Klaus Iohannis blaming Russia for the incursion. The incident represents a rare direct military confrontation between a NATO member and Russian forces in the region.

sources.headline: Romanian jet blasts drone near offshore gas platform, president blames Moscow

europe_now.title: Irish alumina refinery alleged as Russian sanctions evasion route
europe_now.summary: An EUobserver investigation identifies an Irish alumina refinery as a potential conduit for Russian aluminium to enter European markets despite sanctions. The report highlights complex ownership structures that obscure Russian control, challenging the effectiveness of EU restrictive measures.

sources.headline: Irish alumina refinery is Russian Trojan Horse in EU sanctions

top_stories.title: Ceuta migrant crisis deepens as Spain expands shelters
top_stories.summary: Spanish authorities have expanded temporary shelters in Ceuta to house hundreds of migrants relocated after a surge at the border. Meanwhile, the European Commission has backed calls to return unaccompanied minors, while Spain assumes responsibility for their care.

sources.headline: Spain expands Ceuta migrant shelters to ease crisis
Spain to care for migrant children, as EU Commission joins far-right calls to send them back

top_stories.title: Russian strikes target Ukrainian critical infrastructure
top_stories.summary: Kyiv's mayor stated that Russian forces deliberately targeted critical infrastructure in the latest wave of missile strikes. Ukraine's military intelligence chief predicted that Moscow will continue missile terrorism and attritional combat in the Donbas.

sources.headline: Russia 'purposefully' hit critical infrastructure in latest strikes, Kyiv mayor says

top_stories.title: Extreme heat and drought strain European health and economies
top_stories.summary: Health experts warn that unprecedented heatwaves are exposing severe climate-related health risks across Europe. Simultaneously, drought conditions in Germany and other nations are driving up costs for agriculture and water supply.

sources.headline: Extreme heat: 'We're really starting now to understand how global climate is impacting our health'
Drought in Germany and Europe are driving up costs

top_stories.title: Irish refinery accused of circumventing Russian aluminium sanctions
top_stories.summary: An investigation alleges that an Irish alumina refinery serves as a covert channel for Russian aluminium to bypass European Union sanctions. The facility's ownership structure reportedly conceals Russian beneficial ownership, undermining the sanctions regime.

sources.headline: Irish alumina refinery is Russian Trojan Horse in EU sanctions
